failure.cause: The spec, not the application. It measured the crew header's three parts with three separate boundingBox calls immediately after placing a person. That placement is saved asynchronously; when it lands the pool loses a row and everything below moves up, so the measurements straddled the re-render and disagreed by 64px — the height of a pool row.
failure.fix: Wait for the settled crew card, then take all three rectangles in one page.evaluate, which is a single layout pass.
